description.en: An interface-only app the store's end-to-end tests publish. It opens .e2etxt files, and .drawio and .docx too, so the store's file-type search has an app to find.

files:read.en: To show the file you open with it.

ui.en: The viewer is this app's own page, run in the sandbox filex draws for it.

ui-viewer:.e2etxt.en: So an .e2etxt file opens in this viewer.

ui-viewer:.drawio.en: So a .drawio file opens in this viewer.

ui-viewer:.docx.en: So a .docx file opens in this viewer.
